title: Regional bookers in Little Rock and Texas
summary: Bookers covered only local territory, like Brady Bryant in Little Rock; Goldberg confined himself to Texas hotels.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: I want to know if some of them were national or some of them just had little territory or something?

No, they just was individuals. We'd book anywhere where they could. When we got to Florida, maybe some guy would know a few of the spots over there. He would book us. In Little Rock, Arkansas, we had a fellow named Brady Bryant that knew most of the places around there. He would book them out. But not any bonded book in the United States. Those things came up way later.
I was wondering if Goldberg had contacts in New Mexico and Arizona.
No, Goldberg confined himself in Texas. His home is now in Dallas where he originally was from. And he confined himself there to the hotels. He was familiar with the managers of the hotels.
